mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review SET user_id = #{userId}, order_id = #{orderId}, rating = #{rating}, comment = #{comment}, image_path = #{imagePath}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.rating, r.comment, r.owner_comment, r.created FROM reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN order_menus om ON om.order_id = o.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM review WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND user_id = #{userId}
